scope: Every name the native Ollama route returns as an unsupported reservation or preparation, with the lane that removes the refusal. Lane IDs follow the Rust core completion program; route marks an exactness guard of the route itself.

additionalParams.reason: Additional request parameters applied to every model.

additionalText.reason: additionalInformations searches the text with embeddings.

assetPrompt.reason: A history message that adds an asset prompt.

banCharacterset.reason: Banned character sets need the tokenizer ban tables.

bias.reason: A bias entry that is not a pair of a string key and a number weight, which TS reads by index.

case-locale.reason: A consumed lore key, message or recursive text requires lowercase mappings that differ under the captured tailored locale.

case-table.reason: Consumed lore matching text contains a non-ASCII code unit under foreign case tables, or a code point whose Unicode 16 mapping the native tables do not reproduce.

cbs.reason: A CBS function or form the native CBS engine does not evaluate yet, or a host-state registration no Send oracle case covers.

cbs.case-locale.reason: Case mapping and function names with I under a default locale with its own case rules (az, el, lt, tr), or without the reservation's capture of the WebView engine.

cbs.case-table.reason: Case mapping beyond ASCII without a capture of Unicode 16 case tables in the WebView engine, or of a letter whose Unicode 16 mapping the native tables do not reproduce.

cbs.local-time.reason: Local time and date forms without a valid capture of the time zone at reservation, or at an instant outside the captured span (from December two years back to 30 days after the send).

cbs.metadata.reason: {{metadata}}, which reads the app version, platform and language.

cbs.random-draws.reason: Random draws the reservation cannot record for the send to replay: more than 4096, or any in a send whose memory card repeats with the trimmed history.

cbs.snapshot.reason: A stored value a called CBS function reads that is not of the type TS stores, such as a non-string character field or greeting.

cbs.trigger_id.reason: {{trigger_id}}, which reads the trigger ID store.

character.desc.reason: A description object with its own toString, or a description and prefix that are neither strings, arrays nor objects, which TS adds as numbers.

customFlags.reason: Custom model flags change the provider request.

effect.reason: A trigger write the route does not store yet: a greeting change, a message edit other than a cut or a text data change or append (a role change, removal, insertion, whole-history replacement or non-text message data), an edited history beyond the stored history limits, or a variable value that is an array, an object, undefined or not finite.

example-case-locale.reason: An example message line whose role prefix lowercases differently under the captured tailored locale (I, İ, Ì, Í, Ĩ, or J or Į before a mark), or without the reservation's capture of the WebView engine.

example-case-table.reason: An example message line whose role prefix holds a non-ASCII code unit under foreign case tables, or a code point whose mapping in the captured tables the native tables do not reproduce.

fmIndex.reason: A greeting index that names no greeting, or one into a stored greeting list that is not an array.

groupChat.reason: Group chats prepare through their members.

historyRewrite.reason: The current-chat parser would rewrite a stored message or store a chat variable.

historySpeakerLookup.reason: A character message spoken by another character.

hostRequest.reason: A sub-request host callback the owner does not answer yet.

inlay.reason: An inlay asset in the history.

inlayViewScreen.reason: Emotion and image views also change response processing.

lore-comment.reason: An activated lore entry has a truthy comment that is not a string when selection reads its source label.

lore-content.reason: A lore entry content value is missing or not a string when selection reads it.

lore-entry.reason: A stored lore list contains an entry that is not an object.

lore-id.reason: A lore entry has an array or object ID when a keep or dont activation variable needs its ID suffix.

lore-insertorder.reason: A lore entry insertorder is an array or object when selection reads its ordering value.

lore-key.reason: A primary lore key is truthy and not a string when selection searches it.

lore-list.reason: Character globalLore or conversation localLore is non-nullish and not an array.

lore-secondkey.reason: A secondary lore key is truthy and not a string when selection searches it.

lorebook.reason: Character globalLore or conversation localLore is present, non-null and not an array at prompt admission.

lua.reason: A Lua host request, such as the editRequest listeners.

maxContext.reason: A context size that is not a whole number, which the turn reads as one.

maxResponse.reason: A response size that is not a whole number, which the turn reads as one.

memory.reason: A memory mode with its summarizer sub-requests.

message-edit.reason: A message edit kind the stored conversation does not apply yet.

message.chatId.reason: A message ID stored as a truthy value other than a string, which TS keeps as the message memo.

message.role.reason: A selected message whose role is not a string, which CBS reads as stored.

messageIdNormalization.reason: A missing message ID, or a falsy or duplicate one inside the prompt, which TS replaces with a stored change.

messages.reason: The conversation message list is non-nullish and not an array when lore captures its history.

model.reason: Only ollama-hosted has a native transport profile.

modelOverride.reason: A separate model selected for the main request.

modules.reason: Selected modules in default composition, or selected trigger, nonempty asset, truthy toggle or MCP URL contributions unsupported by the module-aware app path.

names.reason: A character or user name stored as a truthy value other than a string, which the response markers convert with a template string.

plugins.reason: An enabled v3 plugin, or a plugin hook or tokenizer host request.

postHistoryInstructions.reason: characterFormatUpdate moves these into the author note before a send.

prebuiltAssetCommand.reason: The prebuilt asset command appended to the global note.

presetChain.reason: A preset chain picks a preset at random before preparation.

promptInfoInsideChat.reason: Stores the prompt on the response and runs editRequest again.

promptSettings.maxThoughtTagDepth.reason: A thought tag depth stored as an object with its own toString, which TS would call.

promptTemplate.depth.reason: A template cache card with a string depth.

promptTemplate.range.reason: A template chat card with a string range.

regex-alternation-depth.reason: A consumed lore regular expression exceeds the native alternation-depth compile limit.

regex-compiled-bytes.reason: A consumed lore regular expression exceeds the native compiled-pattern byte limit.

regex-pattern-units.reason: A consumed lore regular expression exceeds the native pattern-unit compile limit.

regex-unicode.reason: A consumed lore regular expression depends on Unicode behavior that the captured WebView engine does not establish as compatible.

regex.dynamicAssets.reason: Output dynamic assets can require embedding and asset host state.

regex.dynamicPattern.reason: An output pattern computed by CBS cannot be compiled before the response is known.

regex.replacementCbs.reason: An output replacement outside the statically proven CBS subset, including recursive stored syntax, dynamic macro names or keys, effects, functions and host-dependent forms.

regex.effect.reason: A script whose CBS stores a chat variable or makes another write during preparation.

regex.emo.reason: An output script with @@emo, or an editprocess script with @@emo that matches, which updates the character's emotion images.

regex.engine.reason: A script pattern or order the native regex runner declines, such as unicodeSets mode, a pattern past the compile limits, or a plan of at least 64 entries containing a NaN order.

regex.host.reason: Active editprocess scripts without the reservation's capture of the WebView RegExp tables and the startup regex exclusion.

regex.inject.reason: An editprocess script with @@inject into a history message, which writes the message.

regex.limit.reason: An editprocess search past the native match limits, which TS finishes.

regex.repeatBack.reason: An editprocess script with @@repeat_back, which reads the conversation.

regex.scripts.reason: A regex script list that is not an array, an entry that is not an object, or an editprocess script whose in, out or flag is not a string.

regex.unicode.reason: An editprocess pattern whose result follows the Unicode version (a property escape, or ignore case beyond ASCII) when the WebView's RegExp tables are not Unicode 17.

regex_nesting_depth.reason: A consumed lore regular expression exceeds the native parser nesting depth.

scanDepth.reason: The effective lore scanDepth, or its root loreBookDepth fallback, is an array or object when converted to a number.

settings.additionalPrompt.reason: An additional prompt stored as an object with its own toString, which TS would call.

settings.descriptionPrefix.reason: A description prefix stored as an object with its own toString, which TS would call.

settings.globalNote.reason: A global note that is not a string, which TS passes to the CBS parser as stored.

settings.jailbreak.reason: A jailbreak prompt that is not a string, which TS passes to the CBS parser as stored.

settings.mainPrompt.reason: A main prompt stored as an object with its own toString, which TS would call.

statics.reason: A send counter TS would not count exactly.

syncBinding.reason: Sync-bound devices stay on the TS route until receive protection lands (route S4).

tokenBudget.reason: The effective lore tokenBudget, or its root loreBookToken fallback, is an array or object when converted to a number.

tokenizer-input-limit.reason: A message or name longer than 1 MiB of UTF-8, the native cl100k counter's limit for one text.

tokenizer-regex-limit.reason: A whitespace run longer than 900,000 code points, which the native cl100k encoder cannot finish.

trigger-stop-sending.reason: A start trigger that stops the send, which the route does not end without a request.

triggers.reason: Active request or output triggers, a trigger led by Lua or triggercode, or a start trigger effect, condition, stored shape or CBS read of a non-string trigger value the start trigger stage does not run.

unicode_sets.reason: A consumed lore regular expression uses the v flag, whose Unicode sets the native engine does not support.
